column1: # The OpenID Foundation conformance suite lane's pass list (#621,
# scripts/oidf/lane.sh): every module of the four OpenID Connect plans and
# of the OpenID4VP verifier plan (#817), in the order the
# suite runs them, with the result the suite gives it and, for a relying
# party module, what FerroSMART made of the provider's answer (accepted,
# refused, no-start, started; none when the module did not run), and for a
# verifier module, of the wallet's presentation (accepted, refused). A failure,
# and a login the module does not ask for, names its issue. Columns, tab
# separated: plan, module, result, login, issue (- for none), reason.
